title: The ten school districts of Niagara County: total expenditure as filed, latest filing
notice: Self-reported annual filings to the NYS Comptroller: given a desk review by the Comptroller's office, not audited. Figures as filed, no inflation adjustment, no year interpolated (a year with no filing is absent, never zero). The reporting basis changed in 2013: figures on either side of it are not strictly comparable. Source: NYS Comptroller, Financial Data for Local Governments, schooldistrict_all_years.zip (snapshot date Oct 30, 2026 for FY2013–FY2026 and Dec 29, 2023 for FY1995–FY2012). Ranked by total expenditure: a size order, never a performance order - the annual report carries no enrollment, so none of these is per student. Only North Tonawanda has a ledger on Public Ledger.
